lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the branchial region. The spatial density is highest near the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable, intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs to form a lattice-like arrangement, particularly visible in the central-lateral quadrant.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with a light-reflective dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple Echeneidae specimens (remoras) are visible, notably one high-reflectance individual attached to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
